source: DGAC Dominican Republic final report (Birgenair 301, 757-225, Puerto Plata, 1996-02-06), FDR narrative and the CVR/FDR sequence: airspeed disagreement on takeoff roll, captain's ASI over-reading in climb, autopilot engaged and pitching up on false speed, rudder ratio / mach trim warnings, overspeed warning followed by stick shaker at ~7300 ft, thrust reduced, stall, left roll and spiral into the sea. No usable FDR trace figures were available to digitise, so ias_kt is the estimated actual (right-side) airspeed and the whole file is a plausible reconstruction of the narrative timeline rather than digitised data. Times relative to t0 and the impact time (about 5 min later) are approximate.

units.ias_capt_kt: captain's (erroneous, left pitot) airspeed indication, kt
